title: looply · 类目管理（Collection）实体关系图 version: v1.0 · 2026-06-04 tables: - name: collection comment: 前台商品分组 note: is_system=TRUE 为系统级（All Products），不可删除/下架 columns: - name: fc_id comment: 分组ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name_en comment: 英文名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name_zh comment: 中文名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: url_slug comment: URL路径段 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: icon_url comment: 入口图URL constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: banner_url comment: Banner图URL constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: description comment: 描述（富文本） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: h1_title comment: 页面H1标题 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: seo_title comment: Meta Title constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: seo_description comment: Meta Desc constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_type comment: 选品类型 rule/manual constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rule_config comment: 自动选品规则JSON constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: default_sort_key comment: 默认排序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: display_mode comment: 展示模式 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: products_per_page comment: 每页商品数 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 active/archived constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 排序权重 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_system comment: 是否系统级 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_manual_product comment: 手动选品关联 note: UNIQUE(fc_id, listing_id)；商品下架后保留记录，is_hidden 可临时隐藏 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: listing_id comment: 商品listingID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 位置（Position） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: pinned comment: 是否固定位置 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_hidden comment: 是否隐藏 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 添加时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_hidden_product comment: 自动选品排除记录 note: UNIQUE(fc_id, listing_id)；商品下架时同步清除此记录（pin不持久化） columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: listing_id comment: 被排除的listingID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 排除时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: filter_dimension comment: 筛选维度（全局池） note: source_type=attribute 时通过 filter_dimension_source 关联属性 columns: - name: dimension_id comment: 维度ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: dimension_name_en comment: 英文名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: dimension_name_zh comment: 中文名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: dimension_type comment: 展示类型 checkbox/range/color_swatch/size_grid/radio/search_list constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_type comment: 数据源类型 attribute/brand/series/price/condition(A/B/C)/size_system constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_config comment: 数据源特有配置JSON constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: value_mapping comment: 值归一化规则JSON constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: min_fill_rate comment: 最低填充率阈值 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 active/inactive constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: filter_dimension_source comment: 维度-属性多源绑定 note: UNIQUE(dimension_id, attribute_id)；仅 source_type=attribute 的维度使用 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: dimension_id comment: 所属筛选维度 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: attribute_id comment: 关联属性定义ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: priority comment: 多源优先级 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_filter_config comment: Collection筛选配置 note: UNIQUE(fc_id, dimension_id)；每个Collection独立配置引用哪些维度 columns: - name: id comment: 主键 constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fc_id comment: 所属分组 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: dimension_id comment: 引用的筛选维度 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: display_name_en comment: 覆盖展示名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 筛选面板排序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_collapsible comment: 是否可折叠 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: default_expanded comment: 默认是否展开 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_quick_filter comment: 是否Quick Filter constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: quick_filter_label comment: Quick Filter标签 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: quick_filter_preset comment: Quick Filter预设条件JSON constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 active/inactive constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: listing comment: 商品上架记录 note: 外部引用，字段由商品系统维护，不在本模块展开 columns: - name: listing_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: attribute_def comment: 属性定义 note: 外部引用，字段由商品系统维护，不在本模块展开 columns: - name: attribute_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: brand comment: 品牌 note: filter_dimension source_type=brand 时的数据来源（逻辑引用） columns: - name: brand_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: series comment: 系列 note: filter_dimension source_type=series 时的数据来源（逻辑引用） columns: - name: series_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: size_system comment: 尺码体系 note: filter_dimension source_type=size_system 时的数据来源（逻辑引用） columns: - name: size_system_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: backend_category comment: 后台类目 note: rule_config JSON 条件字段引用（非FK），不作为筛选维度数据源 columns: - name: category_id comment: （商品系统） constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: collection to: fc_manual_product type: 1:N label: 手动选品 color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.8 - from: collection to: fc_hidden_product type: 1:N label: 排除记录 color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.4 - from: collection to: fc_filter_config type: 1:N label: 筛选配置 color: '#2D72B8' penwidth: 1.4 - from: filter_dimension to: fc_filter_config type: 1:N label: 被引用 color: '#2E7D4F' penwidth: 1.4 - from: filter_dimension to: filter_dimension_source type: 1:N label: 多源绑定 color: '#2E7D4F' penwidth: 1.4 - from: listing to: fc_manual_product type: 1:N label: FK color: '#9E9E9E' penwidth: 1.0 - from: listing to: fc_hidden_product type: 1:N label: FK color: '#9E9E9E' penwidth: 1.0 - from: attribute_def to: filter_dimension_source type: 1:N label: FK color: '#9E9E9E' penwidth: 1.0 - from: brand to: filter_dimension type: '' label: source_type=brand color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: series to: filter_dimension type: '' label: source_type=series color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: size_system to: filter_dimension type: '' label: source_type=size_system color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed - from: backend_category to: collection type: '' label: 'rule_config 条件字段
（JSON引用，非FK）' color: '#BDBDBD' penwidth: 0.8 style: dashed design_rules: R-01: Collection 无层级嵌套，扁平结构，导航层级由 Navigation 模块承载 R-02: 商品粒度为 listing 级别，不按 SPU 聚合 R-03: 自动选品/手动选品两种模式互斥（source_type=rule 或 manual） R-04: All Products 为系统级 Collection（is_system=TRUE），不可删除、不可下架、rule_config 为空（全量） R-05: 自动选品商品下架时同步清除 fc_hidden_product 中的对应 pin 记录（不持久化） R-06: 手动选品商品下架后 fc_manual_product 记录保留，is_hidden=TRUE，商品重新上架后恢复 R-07: backend_category 不作为 filter_dimension 的 source_type，仅用于 rule_config 条件字段 R-08: filter_dimension source_type=attribute 时，通过 filter_dimension_source 支持多个 attribute_def 绑定到同一维度 R-09: 后台商品列表顺序 = 前端实际展示顺序（WYSIWYG），sort_order 字段即最终渲染位置 R-10: Quick Filter 商品数为 0 时前端自动隐藏该 Chip（实时判断） R-11: filter_dimension 填充率低于 min_fill_rate 时前台自动隐藏该维度分组（每日 cron 更新）
